admin.description: Put Ask IS on other websites: a chat link, a chat bubble or a frame, for signed-in people or for anyone.

signed_in.hint: People sign in with their work account. Answers use what they may read, and they can raise tickets.

anyone.label: Anyone
anyone.hint: No sign-in. Answers use public articles of the categories you choose. No tickets.
